description: This Java class 'UtilTimer' provides utility methods for timing and logging execution durations, including start, stop, and reporting functions, with support for nested timing levels and static timer management.

classes.name: UtilTimer
classes.description: A utility class for measuring and reporting elapsed time during process execution, with features for nested timing, logging, and static timer management.

methods.name: makeTimer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new UtilTimer instance.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Initializes the timer start time and marks the timer as running.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the timer.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the timer is currently running.

methods.name: timerString
methods.description: Generates a timing report string with a message, including total and interval times.

methods.name: secondsSinceStart
methods.description: Returns seconds elapsed since timer start.

methods.name: secondsSinceLast
methods.description: Returns seconds elapsed since last timerString call.

methods.name: timeSinceStart
methods.description: Returns milliseconds elapsed since timer start.

methods.name: timeSinceLast
methods.description: Returns milliseconds elapsed since last timerString call.

methods.name: timerString
methods.description: Generates a nested level timing report string with indentation.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a static timer by name.

methods.name: timerLog
methods.description: Logs a message with timing info for a named timer.

methods.name: closeTimer
methods.description: Stops and removes a static timer, optionally logging a message.
